observations: White PlayStation 5 Slim console with a vertical split design.
A power cable with a two-pin plug is visible.
A white paper document with 'SONY' and 'PlayStation 5' printed on it.
The console is shown outside of its retail box in both photos.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI E GAMES' is present on both images.

claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show one controller
No game disc is visible in either photo.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a hardware fault.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video showing a game disc being inserted and the system recognizing it.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the system settings.
Video of a game disc being inserted and recognized by the console.
Video of the console connected to the internet and logged into PSN.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PlayStation 5 Slim from the photos. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (not working) until proof of operation is provided.
